versions.ghc: The Glorious Glasgow Haskell Compilation System, version 9.10.2

profiles.name: local

resources.method: sampled owned process tree including Chromium descendants and PostgreSQL workers; sampler PowerShell excluded; short-lived helpers may be missed
resources.scope: matching live profile from initial transcript view through resume, concurrent production/ordinary MCP/three browsers and drain; source generation included, seeding excluded

profiles.inputScope: actual Shift key on the focused product transcript to two animation frames, including driver/native main-thread delay; does not replace the existing frontend local-interaction suite

slowObserver.scope: server-side proxy socket read pause/disconnection; not a claim of kernel send-buffer saturation

database.scope: logical executions and sampled lock waiters, not TCP round trips or exact cumulative waits

inferredHelperStarts.basis: verified classic artifact one-helper-per-successful-follower-HTTP mapping; changed artifacts and pre-network failures are unobserved

limitations: Three witnesses are correlated views of one source stream; browser count never multiplies independent samples.
Visible high water represents coalesced committed progress; intermediate sequences may be superseded.
Missing old-path progress remains censored; no completion percentile is invented.
Dispatch measurement includes server dispatch plus loopback receipt and is not an exact send timestamp.

independentLatency.scope: unique canonical commit/outbox/revision-changing raster cohorts; correlated source markers and three views never multiply independent counts

profiles.latencySamplingDisposition: insufficient independent qualification cohorts; preserve actual baseline observations/censoring

resourceCeilings.scope: same live record/rate/profile; CPU/SQL allowance = per-generated-MiB live allowance plus one linear complete-prefix reference allowance; RSS has 25% plus 64 MiB headroom and never scales with prefix size
